item.title: Past and present thoughtbotters at LRUG this Monday
item.content:encoded: Come hear Ruby talks by Fritz Meissner and Ismael Celis at the London Ruby User Group meeting on Monday 13th July.

item.title: The Bike Shed Ep 505: What is a “principal” or “staff” engineer?
item.content:encoded: Sally and Joël join forces to discuss the different ways to interpret the role of a ‘principle’ or ‘staff’ engineer, and the handwaving around what those titles mean in terms of the gradation.

item.title: Your vibe coded website is going to get you fined
item.content:encoded: Vibe coding might get you 80% of the way there. But the other 20% is what really counts. It’s what makes you stand out from AI slop and helps you avoid huge accessibility fines. thoughtbot designers can give you that extra 20%.
